jobs.name: fitness-daily-workout
jobs.description: Daily workout: design + calendar booking + Telegram summary

payload.message:
Run the daily workout scheduler.

1. Check current weather conditions and temperature.
2. Select equipment based on weather (indoor vs outdoor building rules from CLAUDE.md).
3. Design a 20-minute workout following the protocol: RPE 7-8, no barbell squats, warm up properly.
4. Book the workout on gog calendar (check CLAUDE.md for calendar commands).
5. Send Josh a Telegram summary with the workout and calendar link.

Output must include: BOOKED_OK or BOOKING_FAILED, and NOTIFY_OK or NOTIFY_FAILED.
Sunday weigh-in prompt. Send Josh a Telegram message asking him to step on the scale and report his weight. Note that lipid recheck is due ~May 2026 and tracking progress is important.

Morning content brief.

Check recent news relevant to TFB, AllOutdoor, and OutdoorHub. Identify 2-3 story opportunities worth pursuing today. Prioritize breaking firearm/outdoor news and high-volume keyword opportunities.

For any strong story: draft a headline + 2-sentence pitch. Send brief to Josh via Telegram.

jobs.name: content-pm-feed
jobs.description: PM content feed + tweet draft Mon-Sat

payload.message:
PM content and tweet draft.

1. Use `xurl timeline @firearmblog --limit 5` to fetch the latest @firearmblog tweets. Note the most recent tweet URL to avoid duplication.
2. Draft one tweet for @firearmblog using the x-tweet-optimizer and josh-voice skills. Do NOT duplicate recent tweets.
3. Send Josh the draft tweet via Telegram with the latest tweet URL for context.

Note: Cannot auto-post. Josh posts manually.

Daily job scan. Search for new content/SEO/editorial director roles matching Josh's profile (content marketing, SEO, firearms/outdoor, SaaS editorial). Check LinkedIn, Indeed, and relevant job boards via agent-browser. Log any strong matches to jobs/memory/. Send Josh a Telegram summary of any new opportunities found.

jobs.name: jobs-followup-reminders
jobs.description: Follow-up reminders for active applications Mon-Sat

payload.message: Check jobs/memory/ for applications that need follow-up. Flag any that are 5-7 days old with no response, or any with upcoming interview dates. Send Josh reminders via Telegram only if there are actionable items. If nothing needs attention, stay quiet.

Weekly job search summary. Review jobs/memory/ and compile a status report: active applications, interviews scheduled, follow-ups needed, and new opportunities to pursue this week. Send Josh a clean summary via Telegram.

jobs.name: seo-weekly-report
jobs.description: Sunday weekly SEO report for TFB/AllOutdoor/OutdoorHub

payload.message: Run the weekly-seo-report skill for TheFirearmBlog.com, AllOutdoor.com, and OutdoorHub.com. Use the Ahrefs MCP for live data. Check ~/.tinyclaw/files/ for any GA4 or GSC CSVs Josh may have dropped. If CSVs are missing, proceed with Ahrefs data only and note what's missing. Send the report to Josh via Telegram.
